about_the_game:
《Mourningwood Lodge》 is a full-motion video (FMV) live-action mystery horror game. As the first installment in the Funeral Houseseries, players will assume different roles across various game modes to participate in a suspenseful horror journey blending conspiracy and fantasy.

In the initially released ​​Story Mode​​, players take on the role of an heir to the ancient sect ​​"Fangxian Dao"​​ tasked with thwarting an evil ritual. After becoming entangled in a series of premeditated events, they are implicated in a murder and must collaborate with others to escape. Throughout the process, ​​player choices will determine radically different game endings​​.

Story Background​

In Story Mode, players take on the role of ​​Yisi​​ (a character name, retained in Pinyin) who arrives at an ancient mansion. Through interactions with a series of characters and meticulous clue collection, players gather fragmented intelligence. These clues become pivotal during subsequent ​​culprit-identification phases​​, directly influencing narrative progression and outcomes.

Game Features​

  • Clue Fragmentation​​: Scattered evidence (e.g., documents, hidden objects, environmental details) requires thorough examination. Each fragment contributes to reconstructing the truth.

  • ​​Information Synthesis​​: Critical choices rely on synthesizing collected intel. Missing clues may lead to fatal misjudgments.

Reflex​

  • QTE Mechanics​​: Sudden events (e.g., ambushes, traps) demand precise inputs (e.g., timed button presses, pattern matching). Failure triggers ​​instant character death​​.

  • ​​Environmental Interaction​​: Examples include dodging falling debris or disarming mechanisms through quick reflexes.

Deduction​

  • Multilayered Mysteries​​: Clues often conceal deeper connections (e.g., contradictory testimonies, altered dates). Players must cross-reference logs, diaries, and environmental cues.

  • ​​Cognitive Challenges​​: Hidden puzzles (e.g., deciphering codes in letters, identifying forged evidence) require logical inference

Decision

  • Branching Narrative​​: Key choices (e.g., trusting a suspect, revealing/hiding evidence) alter alliances, unlock/close story paths, and trigger chain reactions.

  • ​​Multi-Ending System​​: 5+ distinct endings exist, determined by cumulative choices. Endings range from "Truth Revealed" to "Eternal Haunting".

content_descriptors.notes:
This game includes  frequent scenes disturbing and horrific scenes of implied violence, gore and mutilation of human bodies. It may have a realistic triggering impact on players with potential sensitivities. Player discretion is advised.
May not be suitable for all age groups.
